\section{What the analysis notices}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \finding{warning} Concurrency never exceeded one rank despite a world size of 8: this ran serially.
  \item \finding{note} 1 contract violation(s): an agent returned something the declared schema rejected.
  \item \finding{note} 1 agent call(s) needed more than one attempt.
  \item \finding{note} 1 trouble event(s) occurred but the run still completed: the harness absorbed them.
  \item \finding{ok} 31 rank reattachment(s) occurred, up to incarnation 13: agent processes were replaced mid-run while the rank roles, their mailboxes, and their context accounts persisted.
  \item \finding{ok} All 1 checkable collective(s) sent exactly the number of messages their closed-form cost expression predicts.
\end{itemize}
